scope: Read-only source and existing local compiled-artifact audit. No reference writes, ROM execution, emulator comparison, new original-ROM build, or gameplay implementation.

pinCoverage.reason: source-lock explicitly excludes build/, .elf/.map/.o and non-data/*.gba. The original source fingerprint and snapshot do not authenticate these compiled artifacts; the hashes in this audit pin the separately observed files.

romTarget.name: English FireRed revision 0 as selected by source-lock
romTarget.claimLimit: Matches the target hash advertised by the pinned local README. No new reproduction build or external provenance verification was performed.

sourceSemantics.counter: include/battle.h:144 protectUses is an ordinary u8, not a saturating bitfield
sourceSemantics.command: src/battle_script_commands.c:6220-6252 resets when last resulting move is not Protect/Detect/Endure; indexes by protectUses; compares table value >= Random() before testing notLastTurn; increments on success and resets on failure; no clamp
sourceSemantics.persistentPriorMove: src/battle_script_commands.c:4250-4259 records gCurrentMove in gLastResultingMoves for obeying moves, allowing a consecutive Protect chain
sourceSemantics.turnReset: src/battle_main.c:3623-3655 TurnValuesCleanUp clears ProtectStruct, not protectUses in DisableStruct
sourceSemantics.otherNamedUse: src/battle_ai_script_commands.c:1856 reads the counter; no modification
sourceSemantics.reachability: Four successful consecutive attempts while acting before the opponent and without switching/fainting leave protectUses=4. Protect has enough PP, priority3, and no ordinary-turn clamp/reset. The fifth attempt reads beyond the declared four-entry C array. This is a source control-flow reachability argument, not an executed original-game RNG transcript.
sourceSemantics.sourceCUndefinedBehavior: Out-of-bounds C access cannot be assigned portable semantics by copying the C table. A fresh WASM compile may have a different layout/optimization.

pokefirered.map:21114-21115 places battle_controller_player.o .rodata at 0x0825089c size 0xf0, ending at 0x0825098c exclusive

compiledEvidence.interpretation: ldrb reads the unbounded byte counter; lsls #1 forms a halfword index; adds table base; Random executes; ldrh dereferences that address with no range check; comparison and notLastTurn follow; success adds1 then strb wraps at256.
compiledEvidence.fifthAttemptPredicate: When notLastTurn, success iff Random() <=118; 119 possible u16 results out of65536, conditional on reaching the attempt. No new probability clamp is inferred.

entireByteCounterLookup.claimLimit: The 512-byte range is present in the pinned local ROM and crosses three mapped object .rodata sections: battle_script_commands.o for counter indices 0..93, battle_controller_player.o for 94..213, and battle_anim_smokescreen.o for 214..255. It does not fit within battle_script_commands.o alone. No claim that every counter value has a reachable whole-game RNG path is made.

recommendation: Keep Protect outside the Skull Bash implementation. A future explicitly versioned FireRed-ROM compatibility policy can read/derive the bounded256-entry lookup from this pinned artifact and retain the exact byte counter, resets, inclusive comparison and RNG call order. Do not invent a capped success chance. Separately verify all lookup boundaries, original-game behavior/provenance as required, checkpoint state and policy binding before admission.
